vyomavyāpistavaḥ
<37> vyomavyāpistavam
|| {śrībhaṭṭāraka praṇītaṃ vyomavyāpistavam} ||
|| {śrīvedajñāna racita laghuṭippaṇīyutam} ||
kapola syandi dānaugha lolākeli samākulam | cirācalamudaṃ vande cirācalagajānanam || 1 ||
ādau darśitamāśumuktidatayā hastena cālambinā viśvāsaṃtviha sābhayena gamitaṃ satyāvataṃ sāgninā || indraṃ bhaḍḍamarū svanena mahatā saṃghena taṃ yatpunasta(-) tsauvarṇa sabhāpate khatunaśśrīmatpadāṃbhoruham || 2 ||
guruṇā rāmakaṇṭhena kṛtasya śiśu bodhinīm | vyomavyāpistavasyaikāṃ laghuṭīkāṃ samārabhe || 3 ||
atra hi etatstotrapadāni viduṣāṃ sammativacanapradarśanamātreṇa spaṣṭā bhavanti | tādṛśa vacanāni sarvāṇi pratyāryādaśakaṃ ekayāhelayā tattadghaṭakānteṣu bṛhaṭṭīkāyāṃ krameṇa sammatiṃ darśayiṣyāmaḥ | idānīntu śiśu bodhāya anvayamātra pradarśana mātratayā diṅmātrameva tāni stotra padāni vyākhyāyante | tathā hi ihatāvadanavarata vighṛta śivāgama svarṇa dāma kaṇṭhaḥ rāmakaṇṭho nāma deśikaṃ puṃgavaḥ rurugīta nava nābhamaṇḍalavartiṣu madhyādīśānteṣu nava pada samāhārātmakeṣu navakamala pīṭheṣu sakalapāśa jāla hanana karaṇabhūtasya acintya mahimākārasya sāṣṭaṣaṣṭitriśata varṇātmaka vyomavyāpimantra rājasya avayavabhūtānāṃ ekāśīti saṃkhyakānāṃ padānāṃ pūjanāya pareṣāmapi tadupāsakānāṃ tādṛśa pūjā siddhaye paramaśiva vācakatva sphorakatayā pratipadaṃ ekaikayā āryayā vyomavyāpistava nāmakaṃ stuti bandhamāracayati oṃkāravācyamityādina navatisaṃkhyābhiḥ āryābhiḥ |
atredaṃ boddhavyam | ruruvarṇitaṃ navanābhamekaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tanmadhye madhyakarṇikaṃ aṣṭadalayuktaṃ kamalaṃ ekapīṭhaṃ tatpūrvādīśānāntā sudikṣu tādṛśaṃ kamalaṃ ekamekaṃ evaṃ navakamalapīṭhāni bhavanti | tatra kamalapīṭhe karṇikādīśāna dalānteṣu navapadeṣu mantrarājasya oṃkārādīni nava padāni krameṇa pūjanīyānīti | tatpūjāyāṃ āryānavakasya krameṇa viniyogaḥ evaṃ pūrvādīśāntakamalapīṭheṣvapi pratipīṭhaṃ ekaikamāryādaśakaṃ viniyojyam | evaṃ navati saṃkhyānāṃ āryāṇāṃ upayogaḥ |
evaṃ navanābhamaṇḍalasvarūpaṃ kalottarādau varṇitam | tadyathā (-)
athācāryābhiṣekārthaṃ navanābhaṃ vivartayet | kāmyānāmapi sarveṣāṃ navanābhaṃ phalapradam || 4 ||
mataṃge (-)
anyadguhyatamaṃ vakṣye kramādaśraṃ samaṃ śubham | vibhajya saptabhirbhāgairmadhye padmaṃ prakalpayet || 5 ||
dvātriṃśadaṅgulasamaṃ suvibhaktantu pūrvavat | bhāgamekaṃ parityajya dikṣvaṣṭasu yathākramam || 6 ||
madhyāṃbuja pramāṇāni padānyaṣṭau samālikhet | caturdikṣudvayaṃ bhāgaṃ aṣṭadvāramathoditaiḥ || 7 ||
rajobhiḥ pūrayet samyagyathābhavati śobhanam | ekāśītipadaṃ devaṃ nava parvoktidarśanāt || 8 ||
pūjayettantramantrajñaśśiva vaktokti vartmanā | <39> tatsvarūpaṃ kālottare spaṣṭamuktam | madhye tu kamalaṃ śuklaṃ pītantatpūrvagocare || 9 ||
āgneryāṃ raktavarṇantu nīlabjaṃ dakṣiṇesthitam | naiṛtyāṃ pītavarṇantu śuklaṃ varuṇadiksthitam || 10 ||
ādhūmraṃ vāyukoṇe tu raktapītaṃ tathottare | īśāne mauktikaprakhyaṃ śuklaṃ vā dik sthitaṃ nava || 11 ||
padmarāgamathovāpi raktagauramathāpi vā | vyomavyāpi śivasyaiva navādhvaravidhauhitam || 12 ||
navanābhaṃ samākhyātaṃ prāsādākhya śivasya tu | madhyapadme śivaḥ pūjyaḥ lokeśāśca pareṣu ca || 13 ||
astrāṇi bāhya vīdhau tu bhaktyā saṃpūjayettataḥ | nāsau liṃpati pāvena padmapatramivāṃbhasā || 14 ||
nitye naimittike kāmye kartavyaṃ bhuktimuktaye |
tathā trilocana śivācāryairapyuktam (-)
kṣetre saptapadīkṛte śaśipadaṃ vidhīssamantāptadaiḥ (vīthī-) dikṣvāṣṭasu ca paṃkajāni parito vīthīndubhāgena ca | dvārāṇyaṣṭa kajāntara sthitapadairantasthito gātrakaṃ padmaṃ syānnavanābhamaṇḍalamidaṃ śrīmanmataṃgoditam || 15 - ||
nanu sāṣṭaṣaṣṭi triśatākṣarādhika sahasrākṣara kayutākṣarādi mantreṣu vyomavyāpipadastuti bandhaḥ kimarthamācāryeṇa kṛtamiti cenmaivam | saptakoṭi mahāmantreṣvapi vyomavyāpi padamantresyaivamantra rājatayā āgameṣu mahāmahima varṇanāt | tathaiva kālottare mantrādhva paṭale mantra rājatvaṃ asyaiva varṇitam | tadyathā (-)
mantrādhvānamahaṃ vakṣye sāṃprataṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha ||
saptakoṭi sahasrāṇi koṭilakṣaṃ tathaiva ca | ayutāni ca ṣaṭtriṃśatsadyojātādvinirgatāḥ || 17 ||
viṃśatkoṭi sahasrāṇi koṭilakṣantathaiva ca | niyutāni catuṣṣaṣṭiḥ vāmadevādviniṣkṛtāḥ || 18 ||
catvāriṃśatkakoṭistu sahasrāṇi tathaiva ca | trikoṭi lakṣaṃ vai vatsa aghorācca vinirgatāḥ || 19 ||
aśītikoṭi sāhasraṃ catasraṃ koṭi lakṣakam | tatpuruṣādviniṣkrāntaṃ mantrabhedaṃ ṣaḍānana || 20 ||
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca | īśānasya mukhājjātaṃ anantaṃ mantrajālakam || 21 ||
īśānamukhaniṣkrāntaṃ mantrajātaṃ sudurlabham | ekāśīti padaṃhyetattantrarājaṃtvanuttamam || 22 ||
triśataṃ piṣṭyadhikākṣaraṃ vyomavyāpīti saṃjñitam | īśāna mūrdhni saṃjātaṃ vyomavyāpipadaṃ mahat || 23 ||
<40> ekāśīti padammantraṃ sarvamantrottamottamam | akṣarāṇāṃ śatatrayaṃ ṣaṣṭyadhikamanuttamam || 24 ||
arcane homakāle ca snānakāle japedguha | pratiṣṭhā prokṣaṇekāle dīkṣākāle tu vai japet || 25 ||
vasordhāre bhūmidāhe tathācodbhuta śāntike | anāvṛṣṭau bhūmikaṃpe sarvotpātau tu vai japet || 26 ||
duḥsvapne durjana sparśe sakṛjjaptvāpramucyati | īśānamantro vaivatsa vyomavyāpi vinirgataḥ || 27 ||
īśānamūrdhamantraistu makuṭādīṃśca pūjayet |
tatpuruṣavaktraja sahasrākṣaramantraja tatpuruṣamantrasya naivedyadhūpadīpādau upayogaḥ | aghoravaktraja ayutākṣara aghoramantrasya kaṭaka keyūrādau upayogaḥ | itthamīśānamukha jātatvāt vyomavyāpi padātmakatvāt mantrarājatvāt makuṭādi pūjopayogi īśāna mantrajanakatvācca aghoramukha janmavadbhyaḥ aṃgapūjopayogi mantra janakebhyaḥ sahasrākṣara ayutākṣara arbudākṣaramantrebhyassakāśāt sāṣṭaṣaṣṭi triśatākṣara vyomavyāpimantrasya sarvamantrottamottama varṇanāt tatpadastutau rāmakaṇṭhācārya pravṛttiriti | asya ca stavarājasya rauravānusāreṇa kṛtatvāt tatpāṭhāpekṣayāstava kartrā uttaratra aṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhika triśatākṣarātmakatvena mantrasya varṇitam | ataḥ kalottarādi pāṭhasiddha saṃkhyayā virodhaḥ | taduktaṃ raurave (-)
atha saṃkhyā śivasyoktā akṣarāṇāṃ śatatrayam || 28 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ śaṃbhorguhyamantraṃ vinirgatam |
mataṃge (-)
ekatraiva samastāni ekāśītipadāni tu ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ śaṃbhorvāmānāntu śatatrayam |
ityupodghātanirṇayaḥ ||
itthaṃ bhūtasya vyomavyāpimantrarājasya prathamapadastavaprakāraṃ prathamaṃ stauti oṃkāreti (-)
oṃkāravācyamādyaṃ śivamanavacchinna dṛkkriyopetam | pañca mahāpraṇava tanuṃ śreyodaṃnaumi sarvalokasya || 29 ||
ṭippaṇī (-) oṃkāravācyaṃ ādyaṃ śivaṃ naumi ityanvayaḥ | anavacchinnābhyāṃ asaṃkucitābhyāṃ dṛkkriyābhyāṃ jñānakriyātmaka aiśvaryābhyāṃ upetaṃ yuktam | pañcamahāpraṇavāḥ pañcabrahmamantrāḥ tā eva tanuḥ yasya taṃ sarvalokasya nikhila jagataḥ śreyodaṃ bhuktimuktirūpasya śreyasaḥ puruṣārthasya sādhakaṃ śivaṃ ādyapadena <41> muktapadasya nirāsaḥ | asya śivasya oṃkāravācyatvaṃ prasiddhameva taṃ naumi stautītyarthaḥ | atra vācyabhūta śivastutyā vācakabhūtaṃ oṃkāra padameva stūyate vācya vācakayorabhedāt | evamuttaratra sarvatrāpi vācyastutyā vācaka padānāmeva stutikhagantavyā | dvitīya padastavamāha vyomavyāpakamiti (-)
vyomavyāpakamamitaṃ māyā pāśupāśanāśināthaṃ yat | vyāpnoti śaktibhiryastadvomavyāmavyāpine namastasmai || 2 ||
māyā paśupāśa rāśināthaṃ amitaṃ vyāpakaṃ yadvyoma tat yaḥ śaktibhiḥ vyāpnoti tasmai vyomavyāpine nama ityanvayaḥ | māyayā paśunā pāśarāśinā ca nāthaṃ sahitaṃ amitaṃ iyattārahitaṃ vyāpakaṃ vibhuyadvyoma ākāśaṃ bhūtapañcamaṃ dṛśyamāna sarvavastūnāmapi ākāśāntarhitatvāt asyapāvakatvaṃ sphaṭam | tat ākāśamapi yaḥ śivaḥ śaktibhiḥ vyāpnoti vyāpya tiṣṭhati tasmai tasyāpyākāśasya vyāpakāya tasmai vyomavyāpine namaḥ iti vyomavyāpnotīti vyutpatyā vyomavyāpi pada vācyāya namaḥ namaskāra ityarthaḥ ||
tṛtīyapadastavamāha tadvaditi (-)
tadvadvyāpakamamalaṃ vyomaparaṃ yasya niṣkalaṃ rūpam | sarvajñatādi tasmai namo'stu te vyomarūpāya || 3 ||
yasya paraṃ vyoma niṣkalaṃ sarvajñatādi rūpaṃ tadvat vyāpakaṃ amalaṃ tasmai vyomarūpāya namaḥ astu ityanvayaḥ | yasya śivasya vyoma paraṃ vyomnaḥ śakāśāt paraṃ bṛhat niṣkalaṃ kalārahitaṃ sarvajñatādi sarvakartṛtā nityatṛpti bodhādi svabhāvaṃ rūpaṃ vapuḥ | tadvat ākāśavyāpakaṃ vibhukamalaṃ nirmalaṃ tasmai śivāya vyomarūpāya vyomavat rūpaṃ yasya iti vyutpatyā vyomarūpa te tubhyaṃ namaḥ astvityarthaḥ ||
caturthapadastavamāha vyomeneti (-)
vyomenānyatsarvaṃ yadvadathastatvabhāvabhuvanāni | paraparayacuttayākhyaṃ tatsarva vyāpinepi namaḥ || 4 ||
he parapara vyomena saha anyatsarvaṃ tvadadhaḥ yat tattva bhāvabhuvanāni śaktyākhyaṃ yattat sarvavyāpine namaḥ ityanvayaḥ | parapara parasmādapi paraḥ parātpara ityarthaḥ | śivasaṃbodhanametat vyomena akārānta vyoma śabdopyastīti anena naivā'vagamyate | sahārthe tṛtīyeyaṃ ākāśena saha anyatsarvaṃ itaradviśvaṃtvadathaḥ tvadvyāpyamityarthaḥ | yat yasmātkāraṇāt tatvabhāvabhuvanāni tatvāni ṣaṭtriṃśat bhāvāḥ pañcāśadbhuvanāni caturviṃśatyadhikādviśataṃ <42> etāni śaktyākhyaṃ tvacchaktirūpaṃ yatkāraṇāt tat tasmāt sarvavyāpine sarvaṃ vyāpnotīti vyutpatyā sarvavyāpi padavācyāya tubhyaṃ nama ityarthaḥ ||
pañcamapadastavamāha rāgāditi (-)
rāgādi doṣayogā'saṃbhavato anādikālasaṃsiddhāt | yasya sadā śāntatvācchivatā tasmai namaśśivāyāpi || 5 ||
yasya rāgādi doṣa yogā saṃbhavataḥ anādi kāla saṃsiddhāt sadā śāntatvāt śivatā tasmai śivāya nama ityanvayaḥ | yasya śivasya rāgādi doṣa rahitaḥ anādikāla saṃsiddhāt bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ siddhatvāt anāditvādevetyarthaḥ sadā śāntatvāt saumyatvācca śivatā śuddhatā tasmai śivāya namaḥ śivapadavācyāya namaḥ ityarthaḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhapadastavamāha antariti (-)
antaḥ pūrvākoṭiḥ prāthamyādatra janma kathitoyaḥ | yasya kadācinnāsau śivasya tasmai namostvanantāya || 6 ||
yasya śivasya yo'ntaḥ yo pūrvā koṭiḥ yo janmā kathitaḥ asau prāthamyāt kadācit na tasmai anantāya namaḥ astu ityanvayaḥ | antaḥ pradhvaṃsaḥ pūrvā koṭiḥ prāgabhāvaḥ janma kathitaḥ udbhavaḥ | ādimadhyānta varjita iti yāvat | kutaḥ prāthamyāt sarvakāryebhyaḥ pūrvavartitvādityarthaḥ | ādimadhyāntavataḥ tādṛśa pūrvavartitvaṃ nā'vagamyata iti bhāvaḥ | anantāya anantaśabdastu ādimadhyayorapi upalakṣukaḥ | na vidyate yasya iti vyutpatyā anantapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
saptamapadastavamāha nātha(-)iti (-)
nāthassvāmīmitraṃ bandudyoktassanāstiyasyeva | nityātsarvaiśvaryātkathitāttasmai namo stvanāthāya || 7 ||
svāmī mitraṃ banduśca nātha uktaḥ saḥ yasya nāstyeva nityātkathitāt sarvaisvaryāt hetoḥ tasmai anāthāya namostu ityanvayaḥ | śivasya śivāgama kathita sārvakālīna sarveśvaratvaguṇasatvāt asau svāmyādimānnabhavatītyarthaḥ | nāthāḥ svāmyādayaḥ yasya na vidyante iti vyutpatyā anāthapadavācyāya namo'stu ityarthaḥ ||
aṣṭamapadastavamāha sṛṣṭyādīti (-)
sṛṣṭyādi kārya karaṇe nānyo yenāśrito hi sahakārī | muktaśśivādimocyā namo'stu tasmaitvanāśritāyāpi || 8 ||
yena sṛṣṭyādi kāryakaraṇe muktaḥ śivādimocyaḥ sahakārī anyo hi na āśritaḥ tasmai anāśritāya namaḥ astu ityanvayaḥ | yena śivena sṛṣṭyādi pañcakṛtyakaraṇe svānyaḥ kvacinmuktaḥ puruṣo vā sahakārī nā'śritaḥ tasmai anāśritapada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
<943> navamapada stavamāha adhruvamiti (-)
adhruvametatprāyo vastu pumarthapradaṃ dhruvastena | śaṃbhuḥ kathito yotra tu tasmai namo dhruvāyāstu || 9 ||
pumarthapradaṃ etadvastu prāyaḥ adhruvaṃ tena yaḥ śaṃbhuḥ nityaḥ dhruvaḥ kathitaḥ tasmai dhruvāya namaḥ astu ityanvayaḥ | puruṣārthapradaṃ etatparidṛśyamānaṃ kāminyādikaṃ vastu prāyaḥ niścayataḥ adhruvaṃ naśvarameva tena kāraṇena yaḥ śaṃbhuḥ sukhakaraḥ śivatākaraḥ nityaḥ nāśarahitaḥ śivāgama kathitaḥ tasmai dhruvapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
atha navānāṃ padānāṃ pūjāprakāramāha padanavakamiti (-)
padanavakannavanābhe pañcatriṃśārṇametadatha pūjyam | madhyastha pīṭhamadhya prāgādīśānta digdala niviṣṭam || 10 ||
pañcatriṃśārṇapadanavakaṃ etat navanābhe pūjyaṃ ityanvayaḥ | madhyakamalapīṭha navapadeṣu karṇikādīśānta daleṣu oṃkārādi navapadāni pūjyānītyarthaḥ ||
atha pūrvapīṭhapadanavakastuvamāha yo'sāvityādinā daśabhiḥ āryābhiḥ | tatra prathama padastavamāha yo'sāviti (-)
yo'sau sadāptaśāstro hitādi śāstāhyanāmayatvena | bhavati narāṇāṃ dayayā parāya tasmai tu śāśvatāya namaḥ || 11 ||
sadāpta śāstraḥ yaḥ asau anāmayatvena dayayā narāṇāṃ hitādi śāstā bhavati tasmai parāya śaśvatāya nama ityanvayaḥ | sārvakālaṃ śāstreṣu vyāptaḥ yathārtha vādītyarthaḥ | āmayo rāgādiḥ tadrahitatvena hitādi ityādi śabdena ahitaṃ gṛhyate | hitā'hitopadeṣṭā ityarthaḥ | śasta anuśiṣṭau iti dhātorvyutpatyā śāśvata padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
dvitīya pada stavamāha yoga(-)iti (-)
yogassadāśiva vapu śaktistasthaḥ karoti sarvaṃ yat | tena yasya pīṭhaṃ tasmai taptīṭha saṃsthitāya namaḥ || 12 ||
sadāśiva vapuḥ śaktiḥ yogaḥ tatsthaḥ sarvaṃ karoti iti yat tat asya pīṭhaṃ tatpīṭha saṃsthitāya tasmai namaḥ ityanvayaḥ | sadāśivasya śarīrabhūtā śaktiḥ yogaśakti vācyā bhavati tatra sthitvā śivaḥ sarvaṃ kṛtyaṃ karotīti taccharīraṃ pīṭhamityucyate | tena yogarūpe pīṭhe sthitaḥ iti vyutpatyā yogapīṭha saṃsthita śabda vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
tṛtīya padastavamāha nityamiti (-)
nityaṃ sadaiva yogaḥ proktaṃ vapurasti yasya no nāśaḥ | śaktīnāmapi tasmai te nityaṃ yogine'pi namaḥ || 13 ||
yasya proktaṃ vapuḥ yogaḥ nityaṃ sadaiva asti yasya śaktīnāṃ nonāśaḥ <44> nityaṃ yogine tasmai nama ityanvayaḥ | nityaṃ yogaḥ śaktirasya astīti vyutpatyā nityaṃ yogipada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
caturthapadastavamāha dhyānamiti (-)
dhyānañcittecchā tanmātreṇā'haraṇameva bhāvānām | iti tatraptyai yasya dhyāna hārāya tubhyamapi namaḥ || 14 ||
yasya dhyānaṃ cittecchā tanmātreṇaiva yasya bhāvānāṃ āharaṇaṃ iti yasya tattṛptyai tasmai dhyāna hārāya tubhyaṃ nama ityanvayaḥ | cittecchāḥ saṃkalpabhāvāḥ sarvakāryāṇi āharaṇaṃ saṃpādanaṃ tṛptiḥ paramānandaḥ dhyānenaiva paramānando yasyeti vyutpatyā dhyānahārāya padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
pañcamapadastavamāha mantreti (-)
mantrapadānāmmadhyātphalārthibhiryassmaryate padenaiva | sarvakriyāsu pūrvaṃ yattasmaitvonnamaśśivāyeti || 15 ||
mantrapadānāṃ madhyāt onnamaśśivāyeti padenaiva sarvakriyāsu pūrvaṃ phalārthibhiḥ yaḥ smaryate tasmai nama ityanvayaḥ | karmārambha kāleṣu puruṣaiḥ phalasidhyarthaṃ pūrvaṃ onnamaśśivāya pada smaryamāṇāya nama ityarthaḥ | smārya śivastutyā smāraka stutiravagantavyā ||
ṣaṣṭhapadastavamāha kṛtvā'pīti (-)
kṛtvāpi sarvabhāvānsanāyakāṃ stava bhuvanānyaḥ | teṣāṃ prabhutvayuktassarva prabhave namostu tubhyamapi || 16 ||
tatva pūrvabhuvanān sa nāyakān sarvabhāvānapi kṛtvā yaḥ teṣāṃ prabhutvayuktaḥ tasmai sarvaprabhave tubhyaṃ namo'stu ityanvayaḥ | tatvabhuvanādhipayuktasya svakṛtaprapañcasya prabhutayā sarvaprabhuśabdavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
saptama padastavamāha proktairiti (-)
proktairguṇairabhinnaḥ kalito yo tena śivapadenātra | saguṇassaśaktimūrtirmāntrastasmai namostvatha śivāya || 17 ||
proktaiḥ guṇaiḥ abhinnaḥ saguṇaḥ saśaktimūrtiḥ māntraḥ yaḥ śivapadena kalitaḥ tasmai śivāya namo'stvityanvayaḥ | suguṇasya nirguṇasya śaktivigrahasya mantra vigrahasya vā sarvasya śiva svarūpasya vācaka pada śivapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
aṣṭamapadastavamāha īṣṭe iti (-)
īṣṭe savyasyeśona tu dharmeṇa so'taṃ īśānaḥ | mūrdhanyādau yasya tu namostvaśeśānamūrdhnete || 18 ||
īśaḥ yena tu dharmeṇa sarvasya īṣṭe ataḥ īśānaḥ saḥ yasya mūrdhani <45> ādau tasmai īśānamūrdhne te namostu ityanvayaḥ | īśvarasya sarveśvara hetvīśāna dharmo mūrdhni yasya iti vyatpatyā īśānapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
navamapadastavamāha tasminniti (-)
tasminśaive jñāne paramātpuruṣa eva vācyeta | vaktramiva yasya śaktirnamostu tatpuruṣa vaktrāya || 19 ||
tasmin śaive jñāne parama eva tatpuruṣo vācyeta tadrūpāśaktiḥ yasya vaktramiva tasmai tatpuruṣavaktrāya namostu ityanvayaḥ | tacchabdena śaivajñānavivakṣāyāṃ puruṣaśabdena paramavivakṣāyāṃ tatpuruṣa śabdaśaktidharmo vaktraṃ yasyeti vyutpatyā tatpuruṣavaktrapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
atha śāśvatādi tatpuruṣānta nava padānāṃ eṣāṃ pūjāprakāramāha etaditi (-)
etattatpuruṣāntaṃ padanavakaṃ pūrva pīṭha padaniviṣṭam | aṣṭācatvāriṃśatsaṃkhyairvarṇairūpetamatha pūjyam || 20 ||
pūrvapīṭha padaniviṣṭaṃ aṣṭācatvāriṃśatsaṃkhyaiḥ varṇaiḥ upetaṃ tatpuruṣāntaṃ etatpadanavakaṃ pūjyamityanvayaḥ | pūrvakamalapīṭha navapadeṣu karṇikādīśāntadaleṣu śāśvatādīni pūjanīyānītyarthaḥ ||
atha āgneyapīṭha padanavakastutimāha doṣetyādibhiḥ daśabhiḥ āryābhiḥ | tatra prathamapada stavamāha doṣa iti (-)
doṣahīnamaghoraṃ doṣakṣayakṛccayacca bhaktānām | hṛdayantatsadbhāvo namo'stu tasmaitvaghorahṛdayāya || 21 ||
doṣavihīnaṃ bhaktānāṃ doṣakṣayakṛcca aghoraṃ yasya tatsadbhāvo hṛdayaṃ tasmai aghora hṛdayāya namostu ityanvayaḥ | sva doṣarahitaṃ bhaktānāṃ doṣanāśakaḥ aghoramantraḥ yasya sadbhāvarūpahṛdayamiti vyutpatyā aghorahṛdayapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
vāmo vilakṣaṇo yaḥ krīḍāvāndeva eṣa guhyopi | prasavānumatastasmai namo'stute vāmadeva guhyāya || 22 ||
yaḥ eṣaḥ vāmaḥ vilakṣaṇaḥ ya eṣa devaḥ krīḍāvān yaḥ eṣaḥ guhyaḥ prasavānumataḥ tasmai vāmadeva guhyāya namo'stu ityanvayaḥ | krīḍārthaka dividhātoḥ niṣpanno devaśabdaḥ vāmaścāsau devaśca guhyaśceti vyatpatyā vāmadeva guhyapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
tṛtīyapada stavamāha sadya iti (-)
sadyo jhaṭityajātā hata janmādyā nṛttamūrtayoyasmāt | muktābhavanti tasmai te sadyojāta mūrtaye namaḥ || 23 ||
yasmātsadyaḥ jhaṭiti(,) ajātā hatajanmādyāḥ nṛttamūrtayaḥ muktāḥ bhavanti tasmai sadyojāta mūrtaye nama ityanvayaḥ | (46> sadya ityasya vyākhyā jhaṭiti(,) ajātā ityasyavyākhyā hatajanmādyā iti | mūrtipadavyākhyā nṛmūrtaya iti | tathā ca sadyaḥ ajātā mūrtayo yasmāditi vyutpatyā sadyojātamūrtipadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
caturthapadastavamāha omiti (-)
omityatra purastādvāstavamaikyaṃ hi lakṣayati vācye | sakala śivoyamabhinno yo niṣkalato'pyatho || 24 ||
atra omiti purastāt vācye vāstavaṃ ai (----) namastubhyam || kyaṃ lakṣayati hi yo'yaṃ sakala śivaḥ saniṣkalataḥ abhinnaḥ ityanuṣaṃgaḥ | athā'pi oṃ tubhyaṃ nama ityanvayaḥ | atra asmin śivaśāsane omiti padaṃ purastāt prathamaṃ aikyaṃ lakṣayatīti vācya vācakayorubhayorapi omityevakārayo yasmāt tasmāt sakala niṣkalayorabhinna eva oṃ ityākāro yasmāt athāpi tasmādapi ityarthaḥ | hetu dvayenāpi saṃbodhanametat he oṃkāra rūpa ityarthaḥ tubhyannama ityarthaḥ ||
pañcamapada stavamāha guhyā iti (-)
guhyāḥ parairadṛṣṭerarthāgopyāśca paśuṣumāyādyāḥ | tebhyo guhyebhyo'pyati guhyāya namo'stu rahasi labhyāya || 25 ||
paśuṣumāyādyāḥ arthāśca paraiḥ adṛṣṭaiḥ guhyāḥ gopyāḥ | tebhye guhyebhyo'pi ati guhyāya rahasi labhyāya namostu ityanvayaḥ | guhyapada vyākhyā gopyā iti parairadarśanaḥ gopyatvahetuḥ | atiguhyapadavyākhyā rahasi labhyāya iti dhyanai agamyāya ityarthaḥ | tathāca guhyebhyo'pi atiguhya iti pañcamī samāsena guhyātiguhyapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhapada stavamāha eketi (-)
eka nṛmūrtinimittaṃ yo māyāṃ sarvathā'pi vihantyapi tu | anyeṣāṃ bhavasidhyai tadgoptāyo namostu goptrepi || 26 ||
yaḥ eka nṛmūrtinimittaṃ māyāṃ sarvathā no vihanti | api tu anyeṣāṃ bhavasidhyai tadgoptā tasmai goptre namaḥ astvityanvayaḥ | bhavaḥ saṃsāraṃ ekasya muktāvapi(,) anyasaṃsārāya māyāyāḥ gopteti kalpanayā goptṛ padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
saptama padastavamāha muktimiti (-)
muktiṃ kurvanpuṃsaḥ tatsaṃsārasya kārya karaṇādeḥ | nidhanaṃ karoti yo'sau tasmai nidhanāya tubhyamapi namaḥ || 27 ||
<47> puṃsaḥ muktiṃ kurvan kārya karaṇādeḥ tatsaṃsārasya yo'sau nidhanaṃ karoti tasmai nidhanāya tubhyaṃ nama ityanvayaḥ | mohārthaṃ saṃsārarūpa kārya karaṇādi nidhanatvāt nidhanakara eva nidhana kalpanayā nidhana śabda vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
aṣṭamapadastavamāha sarveti (-)
sarvā vidyāmantrāḥ koṭyassaptādhipāstvanantādyāḥ | yasmādbhavanti tasmai tu sarva vidyādhipāya namaḥ || 28 ||
saptakoṭyaḥ mantrāḥ sarvāḥ vidyāḥ anantādyāḥ adhipāḥ yasmādbhavanti tasmai sarva vidyādhipāya nama ityanvayaḥ | sarvavidyāḥ adhipāśca yasmāditi vyutpatyā sarvavidyādhipa pada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
navamapada stavamāha jyotiriti (-)
jyotissakalaṃ yatprāk puṃsāṃ rūpayati tattu muktoyaḥ | sarvārtha citkriyābhyāṃ jyotīrūpāya tubhyamapi namaḥ || 29 ||
puṃsāṃ prāk yat sakalaṃ jyātiḥ tanmuktau tu sarvārtha citkriyābhyāṃ yaḥ rūpayati tasmai jyotīrūpāya tubhyaṃ nama ityanvayaḥ | jyotiḥ rūpayati vyaṃjayati iti vyutpatyā jyotirūpapadavācyāya tubhyaṃ nama ityarthaḥ ||
atheṣāṃ navapadānāṃ pūjāvidhimāha padanavakamiti (-)
padanavakametadāhuḥ kramatasvāgneya pīṭhaniviṣṭam | aṣṭācatvāriṃśadvarṇayutaṃ pūrvavattu saṃpūjyam || 30 ||
āgneya pīṭha niviṣṭaṃ aṣṭācatvāriṃśadvarṇayutaṃ etatpadanavakaṃ kramataḥ pūrvavatpūjyaṃ ityanvayaḥ | atra pīṭhe aghorahṛdayādīni navāni padāni pūjanīyānītyarthaḥ ||
athaprathamapadastavamāha prameśā iti (-)
parameśā vidyeśāḥ pūrvoddiṣṭāḥ parastu teṣāṃ yaḥ | sva samatva kṛtestasmai te parameśvara parāya namaḥ || 31 ||
pūrvoddiṣṭāḥ vidyeśāḥ sva samatvakṛteḥ parameśāḥ teṣāṃ tu yaḥ paraḥ tasmai parameśvara parāya te nama ityanvayaḥ | parameśvarebhyo'nantādībhyaḥ para iti vyutpatyā parameśvara parapadavācyāya namaḥ ityarthaḥ ||
dvitīyapadastavamāha paśuvaditi (-)
paśuvannoyasyāsti dveṣādiyutā tu cetanā bauddhī | muktaśśivavaccetanā nāsīdacetanā cetana namaste || 32 ||
he acetanācetana yasya paśuvat dveṣādiyutā bauddhī cetanā tu no asti mukta śivavacca cetanā nāsīt tasmai te nama ityanvayaḥ | paśu cetanā yasya navidyate saḥ acetanaḥ | <48> mukta cetanā yasya navidyate sopyacetanaḥ iti vyutpatyā acetanācetana padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
tṛtīyapada stavamāha niṣkaleti (-)
niṣkala vatsakalākhyā tanmūrttivyoma yasya rūpeṇa | vyāptyādi naiva niyatā vyomāstu te namastasmai || 33 ||
he vyomavyoma yasya tava sakalākhyā mūrttiḥ niṣkalavat vyāptādinā rūpeṇaiva vyomaniyatā niścayārthaḥ dviruttayā tasmai te nama ityanvayaḥ | vyoma śabdasya nitya napuṃsakatvāt mūrti śabdena strīliṃgena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nā'nupapannam | vyomedaṃ vyomedamiti dvirūktyā vyomavyomapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
caturthapadastavamāha tadvaditi (-)
tadvaccayasya mūrtissakalārthavyāpikaiva nāvyāptiḥ | prāṅmuktavattu tasmai vyāpinyāpinnamo'stu tubhyamapi ||
yasya ca mūrtistadvat sakalārtha vyāpikaiva muktavat prāgavyāptiḥ na tasmai tubhyaṃ he vyāpinyāpin namo'stu tadvat vyomavat ityarthaḥ | atra vyāpikaiva nāvyāptiriti niyamāt vyāptinyāpinpadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
pañcamapadastavamāha varṇeti (-)
varṇaracane hi rūpaṃ paśumūrtau tadrasādisahitañca | mūrtau na vidyate yasya tu tasmaitvarūpya rūpinnamaḥ || 35 ||
paśumūrtau varṇa racanehi rūpaṃ tadrasādi sahitaṃ ca yasya te mūrtau tat na vidyate tasmai te nama ityanvayaḥ | varṇaḥ brāhmaṇatvādiḥ racanā avayava vinyāsa viśeṣaḥ rasādiḥ madhura gandhādiḥ varṇātmakañca rūpaṃ racanātmakañca rūpaṃ ubhayaṃ nāsti | kalpanayā arūpyarūpi padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ |
ṣaṣṭhapada stavamāha prathameti (-)
prathamā ca prathamāna dvitīyādi yutaiva mūrtiryat | mūrtiryasyā preryā prathama prathamāstu te namastasmai || 36 ||
he prathama prathama sarvamūrti prathamā ca prathamānā bhūtvā dvitīyādi yutaiva iti yat tasmāddhetoḥ sā prathama prathamānetyadhyāhāraḥ yasya tavamūrtiḥ prathamā apreryā satī prathamāna dvitīyādi sahitā tasmai te namostvityanvayaḥ prathama dvitīyāvasthā bhedaḥ śiva mūrtirnityatvāt nāvasthā bheda iti bhāvaḥ ||
saptamapadastavamāha sarveti (-)
sarvajñataiva tejastanmūrtau yasya rūpamathanānyat | pūrvaniṣedhāttasmai tejastejo namo'stu tubhyamapi || 37 ||
<49> yasya tanmūrtau sarvajñatā teja eva rūpaṃ athānyanna kutaḥ pūrvaniṣedhāt tasmai tubhyaṃ he tejastejaḥ namo'stvityanvayaḥ | arūpītyatra rūpaniṣedhaḥ pūrva niṣedhaḥ teja eva rūpamiti niyamāt dvirūttayā tejastejaḥ pada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
aṣṭama padastavamāha jyotiriti (-)
jyotistu sarvakṛtyaṃ rūpadāhādi kartṛ lakṣaṇayā | tadapi ca mūrtau yasya jyātirjyotirnamostu tasmai te || 38 ||
dāhādi kartṛlakṣaṇayā sarva kṛtyantu jyotīrūpaṃ tadapi yasya mūrtau tasmai te namo'stvityanvayaḥ | atra jyotistviti śabdasya evakārārtha tayā niyamasphuraṇāt dvirūktyā jyotirjotiḥ padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
navamapadastavamāha taditi (-)
taccārkasomaśikhimaṇi tejorūpaṃ na kiñcana hi bhāvyam | sadaiva tava vimalaṃ yasya tu tasmaitvarūpate'stu namaḥ || 39 ||
arka soma śikhimaṇi tejorūpaṃ kiñcana sadā bhāvyaṃ nahi yasya tava vimalaṃ rūpaṃ sadaiva bhāvyaṃ taddhetoḥ he arūpa tasmai te namo'stvityanvayaḥ | śikhī vahniḥ vīryāditejasāṃ rūpaṃ sadānabhāsate malinastvasambhavāt śivatejastu malinatvā'saṃbhavāt bhāsate | tasmāt malina rūpa rahitatayā arūpa pada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
atheṣāṃ navānāṃ padānāṃ pūjāprakāramāha rurugīteti (-)
rurugītā rūpāntyaṃ dakṣiṇapīṭhasthametadatha pūjyam | padanavakaṃ pañcādhikacatvāriṃśatpramāṇavarṇayutam || 40 ||
rurugītā rūpāntyaṃ dakṣiṇapīṭhasthaṃ pañcādhika catvāriṃśadvarṇayutaṃ etatpada navakaṃ atha pūjyamityanvayaḥ | asminpīṭhe parameśvara parādīni nava padāni pūjanīyānītyarthaḥ ||
naiṛta pīṭha padastavamāha agnerityādinā navabhirāryābhiḥ |
tatra prathama padastvamāha (-)
agneraindhanaṭhevadyutakālānala lakṣaṇādidañcānyat | sakala mala dahana heturjyotiryasya tu namostvanagne te ||
aindhana vaidyuta kālānala lakṣaṇāt agneḥ anyat sakalamala dahana hetuḥ jyotiḥ yasya tu bhavati tasmai te he anagne namo'stvityanvayaḥ | svajyoti rūpāt anyo'gni navidyate yasyeti vyutpatyā anagnipada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
dvitīyapadastavamāha taditi (-)
tajjyotiṣassadhūmādrāgadveṣādi citprakaṃpayujaḥ | pudgalakādapyanyajjyotiryasyatvadhūmate'stu namaḥ || 42 ||
<50> yasya jyotiḥ sadhūmāt tajjyotiṣaḥ rāgadveṣādi citprakaṃpayujaḥ pudgalakādapi jyotiṣaḥ anyat tasmai te he adhūma te namo'stu ityanvayaḥ | na vidyate jyotiḥ yasyeti vyutpatyā adhūmapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ | tṛtīyapadastavamāha tadvaditi (-)
tadvacca bhasmayuktāttadasārajyotiṣo nṛkartṛkatvāt | sarvārthamanyaduktaṃ jyotiryasya tu namostvabhasma tava || 43 ||
yasya tava anyat uktaṃ sarvārthaṃ jyotiḥ tadvat bhasmayuktāt tadasāra nṛkartṛkatvāt jyotiṣo anyat tasmai te he abhasma namo'stvityanvayaḥ | na vidyate jyotiḥ bhasma yasyetivyutpatyā abhasmapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
caturthapadastavamāha taditi (-)
tajjyotirūpāsau mūrtissaiṣā svabhāvato vimalā | sakalaśreyo heturyasyānādi namo'stvanādete || 44 ||
yasya asau mūrtiḥ tajjyotirūpā svabhāvato vimalā saiṣā sakalaśreyohetuḥ anādiḥ tasmai te he anade namo'stvityanvayaḥ | śivamūrtesnāditvāt śivasyāpi anāditvāt anādipadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
pañcamapadastavamāha nāpuruṣa iti (-)
nāpuruṣatritayaṃ haraharikamalodbhavaṃ hi poṣayati | nā nā nā tvaktokta striyātmā yo namastasmai || 45 ||
nāpuruṣa tritayaṃ harahari kamalodbhavaṃ poṣayati hi tataḥ atra śāsane yaḥ tritayātmāsan nā nā nā uktaḥ tasmai nama ityanvayaḥ | haraharibrahmaṇāṃ nṝṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ vācakatayā nā nā nā padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhapadastavamāha saṃhāreti (-)
saṃhāresvatritayaṃ kaṃpayati yena tena guṇavṛtyā | dhūkāratraya vācyo yotra tu tasmai namo'stu tubhyamapi || 46 ||
sva tritayaṃ saṃhāre vartate yena kāraṇena tena hetunā dhūkaṃpana ityarthamavalaṃbhya kaṃpayatīti guṇavṛtyā yaḥ dhūkāratrayavācyaḥ tasmai tubhyaṃ namo'stvityanvayaḥ | pralayeṣu kaṃpana saṃbhavāt kaṃpana śabdasya saṃhāra lakṣakatve sati susādhya pralayatraya vācaka dhū dhū dhū pada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
saptama padastavamāha stutiriti (-)
stutirūpamasatyamarthaṃ manujātannaitaditi ya āliṅgya | oṃbhūriti satyārthai mantrapadairucyate namostvoṃbhūḥ || 47 ||
etat manujātaṃ lokapaṭhyamāna mantrajālaṃ stutirūpaṃ asatyārthaṃ <51> neti oṃbhūḥ ityāliṅgya vācyaḥ yaḥ śivaḥ satyārthaiḥ mantrapadaiḥ ucyate tasmai tubhyaṃ oṃbhūḥ namo'stvityanvayaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ oṃ śabdena śiva ucyate bhūḥ lokaḥ oṃ bhūrityanena lokeśayorabhedaḥ sphurati tataśca vedāntibhiḥ lokānāmasatya varṇanāt tatpratipādakamantrāṇāṃ asatyārtha śaṃkānirastā | lokasya satyabhūta śivābheda varṇanayā satvasaṃbhavāt | ata eva satyārthā eva sarve mantrāḥ iti pratīti phalaka oṃbhūḥpada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
aṣṭamapadastavamāha omiti (-)
omiti ceśassabhuvo bhuvanasametasya tatvabhāvādeḥ | sakalopi yo'tra kathitastvoṃbhuva iti namo'stu tasmai ca || 48 ||
omiti asmin śāsane omiti yaḥ īśaḥ kathitaḥ sa eva bhuvana sametasya tatva bhāvādeḥ sakalo'pibhuvaḥ sa eva kathitaḥ oṃbhuva iti kathitaḥ tasmai namoṃ'stvityanvayaḥ | īśa bhuvarlokā'bheda bodhaka oṃbhuvaḥ padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
navama padastvamāha omiti (-)
paramā prīti svariti paramasukhātmikaiva yasyoktam | rūpaṃ mukhyaṃ kṛtakaṃ hmoṃ svaritītthaṃ namo'stu tasmai te || 49 ||
omiti paramā prītiḥ svariti paramasukhātmikaiva itthaṃ kṛtakaṃ rūpaṃ parama prītiḥ parama sukhākāraṃ rūpaṃ yasya oṃ svaḥ ityuktaṃ tasmai te namo'stvityanvayaḥ | parama premāspada paramānandabodhaka oṃ svaḥ pada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
eṣāṃ padānāṃ pūjāprakāramāha padanavakamiti (-)
padanavakametaditthaṃ rurugītaṃ sarvadaiva navanābhe | naiṛta pīṭhe pūjyaṃ yuktaṃ varṇaistu paṃcaviṃśatyā || 50 ||
itthaṃ rurugītaṃ pañcaviṃśatyā varṇaistu yuktaṃ etatpadanavakaṃ navanābhe naiṛtapīṭhe sarvadaiva pūjyamityanvayaḥ | naiṛtapīṭhe anagne ityādi navapadāni pūjyānītyarthaḥ |
paścimapīṭha padanavakastavamāha śambhurityādibhiḥ navabhirāryābhiḥ | tatra prathamapadastavamāha śambhuriti (-)
śambhuranidhano gīto māyācakra pravāhataḥ kintu | kūṭastha tayā yosau namo'stu tepyanidhanā nidhanatasmai || 51 ||
yo'sau śaṃbhuḥ māyācakrapravāhataḥ māyā ca kṛsya prapañcasya anāditayā pravāhāt hetoḥ tatkartā anidhanaḥ nidhanaṃ nāśaḥ tadrahitaḥ anāśaḥ karturabhāve pravāhānupapatteḥ | kiñca kūṭasthatayā ca anidhanaḥ kūṭasthasyā'vikāritva lakṣaṇatvāt nāśarahitaḥ <52> tasmai te he anidhanā'nidhana namo'stvityanvayaḥ | ubhayathāpi nāśarahitatvāt anidhanānidhanapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
dvitīyapadastavamāha nidhaneti (-)
nidhanodbhavādi yasmād bhavati śivād vīrabhadramukhyānām | māyāgarbheśānānnidhanodbhavate namo'stu tasmai ca || 52 ||
yasmāt śivāt vīrabhadramukhyānāṃ māyāgarbheśānāṃ nidhanodbhavādi bhavati saṃhāra sṛṣṭyādi bhavantītyarthaḥ tasmai te he nidhanodbhava namo'stu ityanvayaḥ | vīrabhadrādīnāṃ nidhanodbhavakartṛtvāt nidhanodbhavapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
tṛtīyapadastavamāha aśiva iti (-)
aśivo śivapadatvācchivona yo bhavati karmarūpaṃ yat | guruvatkevalamaśubhaṃ vyanaktiyastena namo'stu śiva tasmai || 53 ||
yaḥ śivaḥ na bhavati saḥ aśivaḥ aśiva pradatvāt kevalaṃ aśubhaṃ vyanakti tadvavatirekeṇa tu yaḥ aśivaḥ na saḥ śivaḥ śiva pradatvāt śaktirūpaṃ kevalaṃ śubhaṃ vyanaktīti yat tatkāraṇāt he śiva tasmai namo'stvityanvayaḥ | aśiva haratayā śiva pradatayā ca śiva padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
caturthapadastavamāha sarvasyeti (-)
sarvasya sarvadā tatsarvaṃ sarvatra karmahetuphalam | janayan sarvaḥ kathitaḥ yo'tu tasmai namo'sarvāpi || 54 ||
sarvasya sarvajanasya sarvadā sarvakālaṃ sarvatra sarvadeśe sarvaṃ sakalaṃ karmahetu karmakāraṇakaṃ karmajamityarthaḥ | phalaṃ janayan yat tatkāraṇāt atra śivaśāsane yaḥ sarvaḥ kathitaḥ he sarva tasmai nama ityanvayaḥ | sarvaphalapradatayā sarvapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
pañcamapadastavamāha parama iti (-)
paramaścāsāvātmā kāraṇamuktastu kāraṇānāṃ yaḥ | cidacidvibhedabhājāṃ sarveṣānte namo'stu paramātman || 55 ||
yo'sau paramaścāsau ātmā ca cidacidvibhedabhājāṃ kāraṇānāṃ kāraṇaṃ uktaḥ tasmai te he paramātman namostvityanvayaḥ | utkṛṣṭātmavācaka paramātmapada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhapadastavamāha pūjyānāmiti (-)
pūjyānāmapi pūjyo vidyeśānāmananta mukhyānām | muktyai maheśvaratvādyastu tasmai maheśvara namaste || 56 ||
yastu maheśvaratvāt pūjyānāṃ anantamukhyānāṃ vidyeśānāmapi muktyai mokṣa phalāya pūjyaḥ tasmai te he maheśvara nama ityanvayaḥ | mahatāmanantādīnāmapi īśvara iti vyutpatyā maheśvara pada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
saptamapadastavamāha mukta iti (-)
muktaśśivebhyopi mahān devaśśāntatvato hi yassākṣāt | tepyarcitāyadarcā tasya tu tasmai namo mahādeva || 57 ||
<53> yaśśivaḥ sākṣāt parānapekṣayā śāntatvataḥ rāgadveṣa rāgadveṣarahitatvataḥ svatassiddha rāgādi rāhityavatvādityarthaḥ muktaḥ śivebhyo'pi mahān devaḥ te'pi muktāḥ śivā'pītyarthaḥ yadarcāyacchivaviṣayā arcā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāssantaḥ tasya arcitā bhavanti | he mahādeva tasmai te nasmo'stvityanvayaḥ | mahān cā'sau devaśceti vyatpatyā mahādeva padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ |
aṣṭamapadastavamāha paśviti(?) (-)
paśudrakṣūttāḥ prāntaiḥ paśupāśāstvīśvarassvatantretaḥ | sadbhāvena yaduktaḥ sadbhāveśvara namo'stu tasmai te || 58 ||
paśupāśāḥ paśudrakṣu paśudarśaneṣu paśu śāstreṣvityarthaḥ prāntai pradeśyaiḥ uktāḥ ye īśvarastu svatantre śivaśāstre sadbhāvena samyaktvena uktaḥ tasmai tubhyaṃ he sadbhāveśvara nama ityanvayaḥ | śivaśāstre sadbhāvena uktaḥ īśvaraḥ sadbhāveśvara iti madhyamapadalopi samāsena sadbhāveśvara padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
navamapadastavamāha sarveti (-)
sarvārtha kṛnmahattattejassādāśivaṃ vapuryasya | prāguktamapradhṛṣyaṃ sadaiva tasmai namo mahātejaḥ || 59 ||
sarvārthakṛt sādāśivaṃ vapuḥ sadaivāpradhṛṣyaṃ prāguktaṃ mahat tejaḥ yasya tasmai te he mahātejaḥ tubhyaṃ nama ityanvayaḥ | mahat tejaḥ yasya saḥ mahātejā iti vyutpatyā mahāteja śabda vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
atheṣāṃ navānāṃ padānāṃ pūjāprakāramāha paścimeti (-)
paścimapīṭhe pūjyaṃ padanavakañcetadukta paripāṭyā | saptatriṃśatsaṃkhyairyuktaṃ varṇaissadaivanavanābhe || 60 ||
saptatriṃśadvarṇaiḥ yuktaṃ etatpadanavakaṃ ukta paripāṭyā navanābhe paścimapīṭhe sadaiva pūjyamityanvayaḥ | paścima pīṭhe anidhanānidhana padādīni navapadāni pūjanīyānītyarthaḥ ||
vāyavyapīṭhapadanavakastutimāha yegā iti navabhirāryābhiḥ | tatra prathamapadastavamāha yogā iti (-)
yogā vimuktadehāḥ proktāssādāśivāśśivasteṣām | adhipaḥ pitṛvajjanako yo yogādhipa namo'stu tasmai te || 61 ||
muktadehāḥ sadāśivāḥ sadāśiva eva sadāśivāḥ paśu sadāśivā ityarthaḥ | svarthe'ṇ pratyayaḥ paśu sadāśivānāṃ vijñāna kalarūpāṇāṃ sakalabandhavimuktatayā vimukta dehatvamityarthaḥ yogāḥ iti proktāḥ yaśśivaḥ teṣāṃ adhipāḥ pitṛvajjanakaḥ adhipaḥ samarthaḥ | tasmai te he yogādhipa namo'stvityanvayaḥ | yogānāmadhipaḥ yogādhipa iti vyutpatyā yogādhipa padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
dvitīyapadastavamāha gurubhiriti (-)
gurubhirmaṇḍalaveṣo dīkṣāyāmarthyate bhiyādinān | <54> bhaktānvā sacchiṣyāṃstu muñca muñceti yo namastasmai || 62 ||
maṇḍalaveṣoyaḥ śiṣyapaḥ gurubhiḥ dīkṣāyāṃ bhiyā sasmārabhayena dīnān bhaktān sacchiṣyān muñcamuñca iti kathyate prārthyate | tasmai te namostvityanvayaḥ | saṃsāramokṣa pratipādaka muñcamuñcapadasaṃbodhyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
tṛtīyapadastavamāha madhnātīti (-)
madhnātītaḥ pāśādīn dīkṣābhiryogurūnadhiṣṭhāya | pakvamalānāṃ puṃsāṃ prathama prathamāstu te namastasmai || 63 ||
itaḥ prārthanānantaraṃ gurūnadhiṣṭhāya pakvamalānāṃ puṃsāṃ dīkṣābhiḥ yaḥ madhnāti tasmai te he prathama prathama namo'stvityanvayaḥ | niyamena pāśamathanāt dvirūktyā prathama prathama padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
caturthapadastavamāha puṃsa iti (-)
puṃso bandhanabhayataśśaraṇaṃ prāptānvṛṇoti gurusaṃsthaḥ | dīkṣābhyupagamato yastu śarvaśarvā'stute namastasmai || 64 ||
bandhanabhayataḥ śaraṇaṃ prāptavān puṃsaḥ gurusaṃstho bhūtvā dīkṣābhyupagamena yastu vṛṇoti tasmai te he śarvaśarvanamo'stvityanvayaḥ | śaraśabdaḥ śaraṇadyotakaḥ | vaśabdo varaṇadyotakaḥ | niyamataḥ śaraṇaprāptapuruṣavaraṇakadyotakatayā dvirūktyā śarvaśarvapadadyotyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
pañcamapadastavamāha aṇviti (-)
aṇuśaktipātamādau gurvādyabhigamanato bhavatipuṃsām | śivaśaktibhāvakatayā yaste bhava bhava namo'stu tasmai ca || 65 ||
yeṣāmityadhyāhāraḥ | yeṣāṃ puṃsāṃ gurvādyabhigamanato ādau aṇuśaktipātaṃ bhavati | aṇuśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ aṇutvaśakteḥ āṇavamalaśakteḥ pātaḥ kṣayaḥ liṅgavyatyāsaḥ cintyaḥ teṣāṃ puṃsāṃ yaḥ śivaśaktibhāvakatayā śivatvavyañjakatayā bhavati tasmai te he bhavabhava namo'stvityanvayaḥ | āṇavakṣayabhavanaśivatvavyaktibhavanahetutayā bhavabhavapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhapadastavamāha pūrvamiti (-)
pūrvaṃ pramathitapāśābhavanti ye dīkṣayā bhavāsteṣām | śivatā tadūrdhvabhavanaṃ bhavati yatastadbhavodbhava namastasmai || 66 ||
dīkṣayā pūrvaṃ pramathita pāśāḥ ye bhavanti te bhavāḥ teṣāṃ bhavānāṃ tadūrdhvabhavanaṃ tasyaiva vivaraṇatayā yatobhavati tasmai te tatkāraṇāt he bhavodbhava nama ityanvayaḥ | bhavānāṃ udbhavanaṃ yasmāditi vyutpatyā bhavodbhava pada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
saptamapadastavamāha jātīti (-)
jātiniyamenaitān muktisukhaṃ pūrṇatāndadātyapi tu | sarvebhyobhūtebhyassukhapradoyo namo'stu tasmai te || 67 ||
yaḥ jātiniyamena brāhmaṇatvādijāti niyamena etanmuktisukhaṃ karoti tat prasiddhaṃ muktisukhaṃ pūrṇatāṃ muktisukhasya paripūrṇaṃ tu aṇoḥ dadāti apitu sarvebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ sukhaprada tasmai te namo'stvityanvayaḥ | sarvabhūtānāṃ sukhaṃ pradātīti sarvabhūtasukhaprada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
aṣṭamapadastavamāha sarvatreti (-)
sarvatra sannidhānaṃ karoti yo nottarāyaṇādi vaśaḥ | muktyarthandīkṣādau sarvasānnidhyakara namo'stu || 68 ||
yastu dīkṣādau muktyarthaṃ sarvatra sarvadeśe sānnidhyaṃ karoti uttarāyaṇādikālavaśo na bhavati tasmai te sarvasānnidhyakara namo'stvityanvayaḥ | sarvadeśe sarvakāle ca sānnidhyakaraḥ sarvasānnidhyakara iti vyutpatyā sarvasānnidhyakarapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
navamapadastavamāha vidyeti (-)
vidyeśa preraṇayā brahmādīnāntu sāṃjanānāṃ yaḥ | sṛṣṭyādi kṛtparasmin namo'stu te brahmaviṣṇurudrapara || 69 ||
vidyeśapreraṇayā sāñjanānāṃ sāṇavānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ brahmaviṣṇurudrāṇāñca sṛṣṭikṛt yaḥ tvaṃ paraḥ tasmai te he brahmaviṣṇurudrapara namo'stvityanvayaḥ | yaḥ brahmādibhyaḥ paratayā brahmaviṣṇurudraparapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
eṣāṃ navapadānāṃ pūjāprakāramāha vāyavyamiti (-)
vāyavyapīṭha etatpadanavakaṃ pūrvavattu saṃpūjyam | ekonaiḥ pañcāśatsaṃkhyairvarṇairūpetamathaparamam || 70 ||
atha paścimapīṭhapūjānantaraṃ ekonapañcāśadvarṇayutaṃ paraṃ etatpadanavakaṃ pūrvavatpūjyamityanvayaḥ | vāyavya kamalapīṭhe yogādhipādīni nava padāni pūjanīyānītyarthaḥ ||
saumyapīṭhapadanavakastutimāha paśvityādibhiḥ navabhirāryābhiḥ |
tatra prathamapadastavamāha (-)
paśudṛṣṭyadṛṣṭitoyohyanarcitaḥ paśubhireva natvanyaiḥ | śreyo hetuśśaivairanarcitā'narcitatvatha namaste || 71 ||
śreyo hetuḥ yo hi paśudṛṣṭyadṛṣṭitaḥ paśudṛṣṭīnāmadarśanataḥ paśubhireva anarcitaḥ natvanyaiśśaivairanarcitaḥ tasmai te he anarcitānarcita namostvityanvayaḥ paśubhireveti niyamādviruktayā anarcitānacita padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
dvitīyapadastavamāha tadvaditi (-)
tadvacca na stutoyaḥ paśubhirapaśubhistu tastu mantrapadaiḥ | svaviracitairvāstotrairasaṃstutā'saṃstutāpi ca namaste ||
tadvacca anarcitavacca paśubhiḥ yaḥ na stutaḥ apaśubhiḥ stutimantraiḥ padairvā svaviracitaiḥ stotrapadairvāstutaḥ tasmaiḥ te he asaṃstutā'saṃstuta nama ityanvayaḥ | asaṃstutāsaṃstutapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
tṛtīyapadastavamāha pūrveti (-)
pūrvasthita pūrvasthita sarvatrāvāhanādi yasyoktam | sannidhiviśeṣacintyaṃ phalāya nityaṃ namo'stu tasmai te || 73 ||
he pūrvasthita pūrvasthita sannidhiviśeṣacintyaṃ āvāhanādi <56> sarvatra yasya tava phalāya uktaṃ tasmai te nityaṃ namo'stvityanvayaḥ | sarvadeśa sarvakālavartamānasya śivasya āvāhanaṃ sannidhi viśeṣāya bhavatīti | tathā ca niyamena dviruktyā pūrvasthita pūrvasthitapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
caturthapadastavamāha sākṣāditi (-)
sākṣātpaśyati sarvaṃ sarvajñatvāttunā'numānādeḥ | sākṣavyapekṣapātātsākṣinnamostu tasmai ca || 74 ||
yastu sarvajñatvāt sarvaṃ sākṣāt pratyakṣaṃ paśyati sākṣavyapekṣapātāt akṣasya pratyakṣasya vyapekṣāt apekṣatayā sahitaṃ sākṣavyapekṣaḥ pātoyasya tat tathoktānumānādeḥ na paśyati tasmai te he sākṣin sākṣin tubhyaṃ namo'stvityanvayaḥ | paśyati paśyatīti dviruktyā sākṣinpada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
pañcamapadastavamāha sadya iti (-)
sadyomuktau sādhanamatulandīkṣākhyameva yastvaritam | racayannamostumuktasturuturvitthaṃ namo'stu tasmai te || 75 ||
sadyomuktau atulaṃ dīkṣākhyameva sādhanaṃ racayan yastvaṃ bhakteḥ iti śeṣaḥ namasturuturu itthamuttaḥ tasmai te namo'stvityanvayaḥ |
dīkṣākhyameveti niyamādviruktyā avyayapratirūpaka śaighrapratipādaka turuturupadabodhyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhapadastavamāha pratīti (-)
pratibhuvanamarkavadyonipatanmāyāndhakārataḥ puṃsaḥ | harati pataṃgaca dīkṣā saṃyojanena namastasmai || 76 ||
arkavat pratibhuvanam nipatan yaḥ puṃsaḥ māyāndhakārataḥ sārvavibhaktikasta siliti vacanāt māyārūpaṃ andhakāraṃ dīkṣāsaṃyojanena harati ca tasmai te he pataṃga pataṃga namo'stvityanvayaḥ | harati ca iti cakārasya evakārārthatayā niyamasphuraṇāt patan gamayati tamaḥ utsārayatīti kalpanayā dviruktyā pataṃga pataṃga padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
saptamapadastavamāha piṃgala iti (-)
piṅgovahniḥstadvadyaḥ pāśāndahati sarvathā kāṃścit | kāṃścitva sarvathā'pi ca namo'stu te piṃgapiṃgatasmai ca || 77 ||
piṃgaḥ vahniḥ piṃgapadavācyo vahniḥ tadvat vahnivat yaḥ śivaḥ kāṃścit pāśān sarvathā dahati | kāṃścitvasarvathāpi ca dahati | malasya īṣatpākādhika pākābhyāṃ sarvāsarvadāhakatvaṃ upapadyate tadvaditi bhāvaḥ he piṃgapiṃga namo'stvityanvayaḥ | sarvāsarvadāhadvayavarṇaṇena dviruktyā vahnivācaka piṃgapigapadalakṣyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
aṣṭamapadastavamāha taditi (-)
tatsaktyanugrahātsvātmani baddhādya gocare puṃsām | janayatyamitejñepi jñānajñānāstute namastasmai || 78 ||
<57> yaḥ śaktyanugrahāt hetoḥ baddhādyagocare amite aprameyejñe sva prakāśe svātmani viṣaya saptamīyaṃ puṃsāṃ anugraha yukta puṃsāṃ tat jñānaṃ janayati api evakārārthaḥ tasmai te he jñānajñāna namo'stvityanvayaḥ | atrāpi niyamāt jñānajñānapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
navamapadastavamāha vikṣobhya iti (-)
vikṣobhya nādaśaktiṃ racayatibindukrameṇa yaśśabdān | puṃvaktreṇaprathamaṃ namo'stu te śabda śabda tasmai ca || 79 ||
nādaśaktiṃ kuṇḍalinī rūpāṃ vikṣobhya bindukrameṇa nāda bindvādi krameṇa ityarthaḥ | yaḥ śabdān sūkṣmā paśyantī madhyamā vaikharī rūpān pumarthaṃ puruṣasya prayojanāya puṃvaktreṇa puruṣa vaktreṇa racayati | tasmai te he śabdaśabda namo'stvityanvayaḥ | śabdotpādakatayā śabdaśabdapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
eṣāṃ navapadānāṃ pūjāvidhānamāha etaditi (-)
etaduttarapīṭhe padanavakaṃ yadrūktapāṭhena | aṣṭācatvāriṃśatsaṃkhyairvarṇairūpetamatha pūjyam || 80 ||
rurūktapāṭhena aṣṭācatvāriṃśatsaṃkhyaiḥ varṇaiḥ upetaṃ yat padanavakaṃ tattu uttarapīṭhe pūjyamityarthaḥ | atra anarcitānarcitādīni nava padāni krameṇa pūjyānītyarthaḥ ||
īśānapīṭha padanavakastutimāha kurvannityādibhirdarśabhirāryābhiḥ |
tatra prthamapadastavamāha kurvanniti (-)
kurvannupādhiniṣṭhaṃ sarvaṃ yo nopalabhyate paśubhiḥ | atisūkṣmatvānnityaṃ namo'stu te sūkṣma sūkṣma tasmai ca || 81 ||
upādhiniṣṭhaṃ sarvaṃ kurvan antaryāmitayeti bhāvaḥ | yaḥ paśubhiḥ no'palabhyate tatra hetuḥ ati sūkṣmatvāt nityaṃ tasmai te he sūkṣma sūkṣma namo'stvityanvayaḥ | niyamāt dviruktyā atisaukṣmya vācaka sūkṣma sūkṣmapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
dvitīyapadastavamāha mantreti (-)
mantrārthatayā niyataḥ kathito yo'nena śiva padenā'tra | proktaissadaivadharmairyuttasmai namo'stu śiva śiva te || 82 ||
proktaiḥ dharmaiḥ sadā upayuktaḥ yaḥ mantrārtha tayā śivapadena atra śivaśāsane niyataḥ kathitaḥ tasmai te he śiva śiva namo'stvityanvayaḥ | niyamāt dviruktyā śiva śiva padavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
tṛtīyapadastavamāha ānantya iti (-)
ānantyataḥ phalānāṃ vistārānnoktamapi tu saṃkṣepāt | sarvandadātyabhīṣṭaṃ parāparaṃ yo namo'stu sarvadate || 83 ||
phalānāṃ ānantyataḥ vistārāt noktaṃ api tu saṃkṣepāt uktaṃ parāparaṃ sarvaṃ abhīṣṭaṃ yo dadāti tasmai te he sarvadā namo'stvityanvayaḥ |
sarvaṃ dadātīti sarvadapadavācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
caturthapadastavamāha iṣveti (-)
<58> iṣvetthamarthanīyaḥ praṇavasto yaḥ tribhirnamaskāraiḥ | bandha trayatastryātmaka kāryadhvaṃ sāyate namastasmai || 84 ||
iṣvā iti yajanaṃ kṛtvā ante bandhatrayataḥ āṇavādi samutpannasya tryātmaka kāryasya dhvaṃsāya yaḥ praṇavasthaḥ tribhiḥ namaskāraiḥ ardhanīyaḥ tasmai nama ityanvayaḥ | bandhatrayamocanāya prayukta oṃ namo namo namaḥ pada smāryāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
pañcamapadastavamāha mantrārtha iti (-)
mantrārtha yo dvayorapyupasaṃhāraḥ padaiśśivāyeti | yadadhiṣṭhāna mantropi śivastasmai śivāya te stu namaḥ ||
śivāyeti pade mantrārthayordvayorapyupasaṃhāreṇa tvaṃ yadadhiṣṭhānamantropi śivaḥ yadadhiṣṭhānāt sadā śreyānityarthaḥ | tasmai te śivāya namo'stvityanvayaḥ | mantrārthasphoraka śivāya padabodhyāya nama ityarthaḥ |
ṣaṣṭhapadastavamāha kāryeti (-)
kāryatve nivṛttāvapi pade ye nojanvanti kāraṇatvaṃ yat | ājñāṃ vinā tadardhaṃ praṇave yo'ntyaṃ punarnamastasmai || 86 ||
kāryatve nivṛttāvapi kāraṇatvaṃ ājñāṃvinā nojanyantīti yattadunārthaṃ punaḥ praṇave svarūpe ye na yojyante tasmai namo'stvityanvayaḥ | yojana viṣaya praṇavākāratayā oṃ pada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
saptamapadastavamāha taditi (-)
taccāpikāraṇatvaṃ teṣāṃ trividhaṃ tribhirnamaskāraiḥ | bandha trayādhikārāt namā'stu te hanti yo namastasmai || 87 ||
teṣāṃ patīnāṃ trividhamapi tatkāraṇatvañca bandhatrayādhikārāṃśca tṛbhiḥ namaskāraiḥ namaskṛto yo hanti tasmai te namo'stvityanvayaḥ | adhikāra trayamocaka prayukta namo namo namaḥ padavācyāya namaḥ ityarthaḥ ||
aṣṭamapadastavamāha tadanviti (-)
tadanu śivatvavyaktistadvṛddhivardhate dvayaṃ yasmāt | dvābhyānnamaskṛtibhyāṃ śivastasmai dvirnamo'stu tasmai te || 88 ||
tadanu bandha trayanivṛtyanantaraṃ śivatvavyaktirbhavati tacchivatvaṃ dvābhyāṃ namaskṛtibhyāṃ yasmāt śivāt nimittāt buddhyā dvayaṃ vardhate tadviguṇaṃ śivatvaṃ bhavatīti yāvat śivatvaṃ prāpyapunaḥ paśutvaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ ||
navamapadastavamāha prānta iti (-)
prānta praṇavaśivo yo'bhidhyātaḥ prārthita phalaṃ tvetat | avinaśvaraṃ śivatvaṃ dadāti puṃso namo'stu tasmai te || 89 ||
yaḥ prāntapraṇavaśivaḥ mantrānta praṇavākāra śiva ityarthaḥ | abhidhyātaḥ prārthitassan puṃsaḥ avinaśvaraṃ śivatvaṃ etatphalantu dadāti tasmai praṇavāya te namo'stvityanvayaḥ | phalasvarūpa oṃ pada vācyāya nama ityarthaḥ ||
atheṣāṃ navapadānāṃ pūjāprakāraṃ varṇasaṃkhyāñca āha īśa iti (-)
īśānakoṇapīṭhe padanavakaṃ tvetadeva pūjyam | tryadhikatriṃśatsaṃkhyairvarṇaivyaktaṃ rurūkta pāṭhena || 80 ||
rurūkta pāṭhena paṭhita tryadhika triṃśadvarṇayutaṃ etatpadanavakaṃ īśānapīṭha koṇe saṃpūjyaṃ ityanvayaḥ | asminpīṭhe sūkṣmasūkṣmapadāni nava padāni pūjyānītyarthaḥ ||
evaṃ vyomavyāpimantra rājasya ekāśīti padastavaṃ vidhāyastavakartrā svanāmaprakaṭayan stavasyāpi kheṭapāla kṛtamantrarājavyākhyānārthānusāritāñca aṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikavarṇaśatatrayākāra mantrasya svaśreyaḥ pradatvaṃ prārthayate | itthaṃ varṇaśatatrayaṃ saha punaḥ ṣaṣṭyāṣṭasaṃyuktayā mantro raurava bhāṣya vārtika girā śrīkheṭapālena yat | vyākhyātorthadiśā tayāstutimimāṃ tāṃ rāmakaṇṭhena yat kṛtvā nāma śubhānvitaṃ bhavatunaḥ śreyaḥ pradaṃ sarvadā || 91 ||
rauravabhāṣyavārtika kṛtā śrīkheṭapāla nāmnā vyākhyātaḥ mantraḥ aṣṭasaṃyuktyā ṣaṣṭyā punassahavarṇaśatatrayaṃ tayā arthadiśā itthaṃ tāmimāṃstutiṃ kṛtvā nātha śubhā kvipiceti śubhidhātoḥ kvippratyaye sati nāthavaccobhate iti vyutpatyā nāthavaccobhamānena rāmakaṇṭhena yat añcitaṃ pūjitaṃ sarvadā śreyaḥ pradaṃ bhavatviti anvayaḥ |
itthaṃ uktaprakāreṇa navakamala pīṭheṣu uktastutikrameṇa vyomavyāpi padamantra pūjāvatāṃ sarvaśreyaḥ prāptiḥ karatalasthā bhavatītibhāvaḥ | itthametatstotra pradarśitānāṃ ekāśīti padanirvacanānāṃ sammatavacanāni tu kālottare spaṣṭamuktāni | granthavistārabhītyā nātralikhitam | etatsvarūpa pradarśaka vacanāni bṛhaṭṭīkāyāṃ darśitaṃ tatra avadhāryatām |
[śrīmadabhrasabheśasya diśyāgneyyāṃ sadāvasan | devajñāna riṣīdreti (ṛṣīndreti) viśṛtobhuvanatraye] ||
[tannāmadhāriṇā caiva iyaṃ vyākhyā samīritā | iti vyomavyāpistavaṃ laghuṭīkāsahitaṃ samāptam] ||
